requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses (12 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses (12 credits): EST 280 - Fundamentals of Industrial Engineering 3 credits; EST 342 - Industrial Engineering, Intro to Operations Research I 3 credits OR AMS 341 - Operations Research I: Deterministic Models 3 credits; EST 392 - Engineering Economics 3 credits; AMS 310 - Survey of Probability and Statistics 3 credits

requirements.label: elective-courses
requirements.title: Elective Courses (6 credits)

rule.manualCheck: Other elective courses may be used with prior approval of the TSM Department.

requirements.sourceText: Elective Courses (6 credits): AMS 315 - Data Analysis 3 credits; AMS 342 - Operations Research II: Stochastic Models 3 credits; ESM 455 - Materials and Processes in Manufacturing Design 3 credits; EST 305 - Applications Software for Information Management 3 credits; EST 326 - Management for Engineers 3 credits; EST 391 - Technology Assessment 3 credits; EST 393 - Project Management 3 credits; MEC 203 - Engineering Graphics and CAD 3 credits; MEC 325 - Manufacturing Processes 3 credits. Note: Other elective courses with prior approval of TSM Department.

requirements.label: major-overlap
requirements.title: Courses not used by the major or other minors

rule.text: The minor must include at least three courses (9 credits) that are not used to satisfy the requirements of the student's major(s) or other minors.
rule.reason: Cross-program course-overlap limit that no rule type covers

requirements.sourceText: The minor must include at least three courses (9 credits) that are not used to satisfy the requirements of the student's major(s) or other minors.

policies.sourceText: Each course taken to satisfy the requirements for the minor must be completed with a grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Admission to the Industrial Engineering minor requires completion of Calculus I and Calculus II (or equivalents) with a grade of C or higher, and a cumulative grade point average of 2.50 or higher.

The minor requires completion of six courses (18 credits). Some chosen courses have prerequisites that may not be met by the minor requirements; students who are not in majors that require these prerequisites must plan to take them in addition to the minor requirements.
